cards.name: Bioshift
cards.oracleText: Move any number of +1/+1 counters from target creature onto another target creature with the same controller.

cards.name: Biosynthic Burst
cards.oracleText: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains reach, trample, and indestructible until end of turn. Untap it. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)
